categories.main_business_segments: Hayward Holdings operates in two primary business segments: North America (NAM) and Europe & Rest of World (E&RW). The NAM segment covers the United States and Canada, while E&RW includes Europe, Australia, and other international markets. Both segments manufacture and sell residential and commercial swimming pool equipment and supplies, with NAM also producing flow control products. In 2024, NAM accounted for approximately 85% of net sales, and E&RW for 15%.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Hayward designs and manufactures a broad portfolio of pool equipment and automation systems, emphasizing energy efficiency, IoT connectivity, and environmentally sustainable features. Key technologies include variable speed pumps, advanced filtration, robotic and automated cleaning systems, LED lighting, water sanitization (including salt chlorinators and UV/Ozone systems), and integrated automation via the OmniLogic mobile app. Manufacturing is conducted at seven global facilities, with a focus on operational efficiency and quality control.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company primarily serves specialty distributors, large retailers, pool builders, buying groups, and servicers, who in turn sell to residential and commercial pool owners. The majority of sales are to the aftermarket for pool equipment replacement, repair, and upgrades, with aftermarket sales historically representing about 80% of net sales. Key end markets include residential pool owners, commercial pool operators, and the broader outdoor living sector.
categories.geographic_coverage: Hayward operates globally, with its largest markets in North America (United States and Canada), followed by Europe and Australia. The company also serves over 20 additional countries through distributors and regional managers. Manufacturing and distribution facilities are located in the US, Canada, Spain, France, Australia, and China, supporting a global installed base of approximately 25 million pools.
categories.supply_chain_position: Hayward is a downstream manufacturer and marketer, positioned at the end of the supply chain, delivering finished pool equipment and automation systems to distributors, retailers, builders, and servicers. The company sources raw materials and components from a global supplier network and manages assembly, quality control, and distribution to trade customers and channel partners.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, Hayward focuses on innovation in energy efficiency, IoT-enabled automation, advanced water sanitization, and sustainability. R&D efforts target new product development, quality improvements, and integration of smart technologies. The company is also pursuing geographic expansion, product portfolio diversification, and selective acquisitions to enhance its market position and address emerging trends in outdoor living and pool ownership.
categories.revenue_model: Hayward generates revenue primarily through the sale of pool equipment and automation systems to distributors, retailers, builders, and buying groups. Revenue is recognized upon shipment, net of rebates and discounts. The business is highly recurring, with a significant portion of sales driven by aftermarket replacement and upgrades, and a smaller share from new pool construction and commercial projects.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Hayward competes with large national and global pool equipment manufacturers, regional OEMs, and lower-cost producers. Major competitors include Pentair, Fluidra, and Zodiac, among others. The company holds an estimated 33% share of the North American residential pool equipment market and differentiates itself through brand recognition, technical innovation, strong channel relationships, and a large installed base.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Hayward reported net sales of $1.05 billion, up 6% from the prior year, with adjusted EBITDA of $277 million and net income of $119 million. The company has demonstrated steady growth, driven by aftermarket demand, price increases, and selective acquisitions, though it faces some regional volatility and seasonality. Hayward maintains a strong liquidity position, with $197 million in cash and access to significant credit facilities.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Hayward emphasizes high-quality, innovative, and energy-efficient pool equipment that enhances the pool owner's experience through ease of use, automation, and sustainability. Its IoT-enabled SmartPad platform, advanced water care solutions, and environmentally friendly features provide cost savings and convenience, supporting premium pricing and customer loyalty. The company's extensive product range and strong trade relationships position it as a one-stop shop for pool equipment needs.
